question: The Treaty of Rajpurghat was concluded by the East India Company with which Maratha power?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Treaty of Rajpurghat was concluded by the East India Company with the Holkar dynasty, one of the prominent Maratha powers.
 
• It was signed in December 1805 after the Holkars suffered defeat at the hands of the British forces.
 
• The treaty marked the end of the Second Anglo-Maratha War, leading to the restoration of territories to the Holkars.
 
• Yashwantrao Holkar was the ruling
